description: Perplexity provides the Sonar, Search, Agent, and text Embeddings APIs.
residency_notes: Perplexity says its compute is hosted on AWS in North America for the API.
prompt_training_notes: Perplexity says API data is not retained and is not used to train models; only billing and operational metadata is collected.

sources.notes: Perplexity's API privacy/security documentation states that API data is not retained or used for training, apart from billing and abuse-prevention metadata.
Official standard embeddings endpoint, authentication, models, inputs, dimensions, encodings, response and usage contract.
Official standard and contextualized embeddings dimensions and token prices.

verification.notes: Standard embeddings endpoint and two routable standard models verified. Contextualized embeddings use a distinct nested contract and are intentionally not registered on the OpenAI embeddings surface.
